name: MAFO
tagline: Cookin' with Junior, live from a single-wide on bingo night: he stirs his Mamaw's turkey fryer with a canoe paddle through a lid bungeed shut, and every rung of the curve the brew turns bluer, the duct-taped gauge pins and gets swapped for a bigger one, the trailer rocks on its blocks, the possum faints and the neighbour calls the sheriff. Cash out to go get ice and hide behind the truck, or stay in your lawn chair, in sunglasses, oven mitts and a motorcycle helmet, for the moment he says hold my beer.
